title: Alternative seismic design category determination.
officialText:
The seismic design category is permitted to be determined from Table 1613.5.6(1) alone when all of the following apply:
1. In each of the two orthogonal directions, the approximate fundamental period of the structure, T , as determined in a accordance with Section 12.8.2.1 of ASCE 7-10, is less than 0.8 T , as determined in accordance with Section 11.4.5 s of ASCE 7-10.
2. In each of the two orthogonal directions, the fundamental period of the structure used to calculate the story drift is less than T . s
3. Equation 12.8-2 of ASCE 7-10 is used to determine the seismic response coefficient, C . s
4. The diaphragms are rigid, as defined in Section 12.3.1 of ASCE 7-10 or, for diaphragms that are flexible, the distances between the vertical elements of the seismic-force-resisting system do not exceed 40 feet (12 192 mm).
